verses.text: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
lines: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs,
you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

verses.text: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
lines: Rise up, you judge of the earth.
Pay back the proud what they deserve.

verses.text: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
lines: Yahweh, how long will the wicked,
how long will the wicked triumph?

verses.text: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
lines: They pour out arrogant words.
All the evildoers boast.

verses.text: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.
lines: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh,
and afflict your heritage.

verses.text: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
lines: They kill the widow and the alien,
and murder the fatherless.

verses.text: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
lines: They say, “Yah will not see,
neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

verses.text: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
lines: Consider, you senseless among the people;
you fools, when will you be wise?

verses.text: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
lines: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear?
He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

verses.text: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
lines: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish?
He who teaches man knows.

verses.text: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
lines: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man,
that they are futile.

verses.text: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
lines: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah,
and teach out of your law,

verses.text: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
lines: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity,
until the pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.text: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
lines: For Yahweh won’t reject his people,
neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.text: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
lines: For judgment will return to righteousness.
All the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
lines: Who will rise up for me against the wicked?
Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

verses.text: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
lines: Unless Yahweh had been my help,
my soul would have soon lived in silence.

verses.text: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
lines: When I said, “My foot is slipping!”
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

verses.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
lines: In the multitude of my thoughts within me,
your comforts delight my soul.

verses.text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
lines: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you,
which brings about mischief by statute?

verses.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
lines: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous,
and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.text: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
lines: But Yahweh has been my high tower,
my God, the rock of my refuge.

verses.text: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
lines: He has brought on them their own iniquity,
and will cut them off in their own wickedness.
Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
